name: Transformer.gg
description: Transformer.gg is a REST API, MCP server and CLI for booking sponsored posts from X creators: search creators who fit a site, send an offer, and track the clicks and sales that post drives.
notes: Public docs cover the REST API, MCP server and CLI. Joining is free and there is no subscription. A 20% fee applies only when a creator accepts a paid offer. Creators can check the value of one sponsored post on an X account with no API key. Transformer.gg is part of North Bay Ventures (North Bay Opco I, Inc., Miami, Florida). The founder is Jon Oringer, who founded Shutterstock.
